title: Mavondzo Lama Dyaka
intro: Ntsheketo wa khale ku tlula mfumo wihi na wihi kumbe tsalwa—khombo ro sungula ra vanhu leri velekiweke hi mavondzo. Moya-xiviri wun’wana, lonkulu eka vana vambirhi lava velekiweke hi vatswari vo sungula, u hlalele hi vukarhi loko makwavo lontsongo a kuma tintswalo leti ariweke. Leswi landzeleke a ku ri ku hlawula ka munyama swinene, ku siya ngati yo sungula leyi tshameke yi halatiwa emisaveni. Xana u nga paluxa vumunhu, ndzingo ni ku tisola lokukulu?
clues: Ndzi velekiwe hi mpatswa wo sungula swinene wa vanhu ku famba emisaveni.
Ndzi tshame ndzi endla gandzelo eka Allah, kambe a ri amukeriwanga eka mina.
Nyiko ya makwerhu wa mina yi amukeriwile, kasi ya mina yi ariwile—ku nga nchumu lowu a ndzi nga swi koti ku tiyisela.
Ndzi xungetile makwerhu wa mina hi ku lovisa.
Ndzi ve wo sungula ku dlaya emisaveni leyi, ndzi teka vutomi bya makwerhu wa mina.
Allah u rhumele xivumbiwa xa misava—xinyenyana xa ntima lexi cela ehansi—ku ndzi dyondzisa ndlela yo fihla leswi ndzi swi endleke, naswona ndzi sale ndzi nga ri na nchumu handle ko tisola.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
